initial_scene: Robot-centered elevated forward view of two forearms and hands facing a stepped brown wooden shelf. A white-topped, blue-fronted and red-sided cube rests on the lowest shelf; the two higher levels are empty. Both hands are initially open.

observed_sequence.action: Both hands remain open near their respective body sides; cube rests on the lowest shelf.
Right arm reaches inward toward the cube with the hand open and positions thumb and fingers on opposite sides. Left hand stays open and does not contact objects.
Right thumb and fingers close around the cube while it remains at the lower level, establishing a secure grasp.
Right hand lifts the cube clear and transports it upward and rearward toward the highest shelf; lowest shelf becomes empty.
Right hand carries the cube over the highest shelf and lowers it toward the wooden surface while retaining its grasp.
Cube is set upright on the highest shelf; right hand opens and begins to lift away, leaving the cube supported by the shelf.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand: grasps cube between thumb and fingers, lifts and transports it from lowest to highest shelf, sets it upright and releases.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains open at the left body side; no contact, stabilization, transfer or support of the cube or shelf.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand transfer; no bimanual coordination or person interaction.

anatomical_side_evidence: The camera looks forward and down from between the robot arms: the active forearm extends from the robot body side at lower image right, and the unused forearm from lower image left. The active hand has its thumb on the medial side toward the centerline in the initial PNG and grasp frames. This robot-centered geometry identifies the active hand as anatomical right, consistent with but not solely inferred from the source instruction.
